# Korean Market Analysis (2026-09-24)
**KOSPI Performance & Global Context:**
KOSPI stood at 7080.92 [f29347eb] as of 2026-09-23, while concurrent US equity weakness saw SPX at 7704.13 [dfa8e47d]. Volatility remained controlled with VIX at 15.67 [d1dbbf9f], suggesting measured risk appetite despite broader market pressures.
**Rate & Commodity Headwinds:**
US 10-year Treasury yield climbed to 5.162% [6dbbe603], reflecting bond market stress. WTI crude rose to $93.97/barrel [af657667] amid geopolitical tensions, while gold strengthened to $4308.9/oz [9944b4e1]—typical safe-haven behavior during uncertainty. The DXY index at 101.248 [3333d4a9] indicates dollar strength.
**Macro Backdrop:**
August CPI remained elevated at 3.4% [2026-08-01], with Fed Rate at 3.63% [2026-08-01], suggesting persistent rate pressure. NFP growth of 162k [2026-08-01] indicated moderating labor momentum.
**Market Sentiment & Risk:**
Fear&Greed scored 36 [2026-09-24T23:37:32], signaling fear dominance. According to WSJ and Reuters headlines, US-Iran escalation fears and Houthi attacks drove oil volatility—a factor that typically pressures Korean exporters and may weigh on regional equities.
